title: Complete idempotent operation results, pending-intent recovery and typed errors

checkpoint.summary: Implemented structured immutable domain results for task/attempt/agent/review/revision/checkpoint/integration mutations, preserving original entity versions, lifecycle/phase/state, assignment generation, checkpoint sequence, and reviewed head/ref. V2 MCP responses expose originalResult directly, and GetOperationStatus verifies originatingCommit via immutable Git history and commit trailers, distinct from the current ledger head. Previous pending reconciliation, typed errors and eight-client contention remain verified.
checkpoint.nextAction: Audit V2-02 against remaining full remote outage, Git history rewrite/restore, ambiguous push and operator recovery acceptance. Then finish V2-01 trust safeguards and begin V2-04 immutable assignment generations.
verified: Cross-clone idempotency, canonicalized JSON hash, duplicate-field rejection, stable receipt after unrelated writer
Failed call/lost-response retained in local journal, conflicting UUID refused, replay clears journal
Opt-in V2 API confirmed writes clear journal; pending intents inspectable without configured remote
Typed LedgerContended/OperationIdReused/OutcomeUnknown/etc. propagated over wire and MCP metadata verified
Eight independent clones wrote separate records concurrently; every operation/receipt retained; source working trees unchanged
Read-only reconciliation distinguishes applied, absent, mismatched payload, mismatched ledger identity; local journal unchanged until explicit hash-matched acknowledgment
Lost remote response is recovered only when exact canonical operation matches; otherwise OutcomeUnknown retains caller UUID, verified head and pending intent
Review submission payload reconciled against immutable pinned review source; repeat acknowledgment is idempotent
Original task and assignment entity results remain unchanged across cross-clone retries after later writes
Original reviewer revision number, exact head SHA and immutable review ref captured in the committed receipt
Yield checkpoint original sequence/kind and agent Ready/attempt Paused versions verified
GetOperationStatus exposes structured originalResult and originatingCommit separate from current ledger head; forged trailer hash rejected
